component.name: Dendro
component.summary: Visual package manager and dependency hierarchy explorer

description.p: Dendro is a modern, high-performance graphical package manager and visual dependency hierarchy explorer built specifically for Fedora Linux.

ul.li: Native librpm and libdnf5 bindings for sub-millisecond database queries
Intelligent semantic decision engine for deterministic package categorization
Interactive multi-level dependency trees with cycle detection
Two-tier capability resolution caching (L1 RAM + L2 SQLite WAL)
Dry-run transaction simulation and automatic system root pillar protection
Dynamic light and dark theming with desktop color scheme auto-detection
Privileged execution with Polkit and live streaming terminal output
DNF transaction history exploration and one-click rollback

description.p: The Engine Hardening and Core Crash Fix Update:

ul.li: Resolved the native segmentation fault on Fedora 44 by replacing in-process libdnf5 worker queries with isolated subprocess calls.
Synchronized layoutAboutToBeChanged and layoutChanged signals in the tree model to prevent Qt proxy index table corruption.
Protected librpm queries with reentrant locking (RLock) and explicit match iterator teardown.
Converted dependency expansion to strict on-demand loading, eliminating startup thread spikes.
Resolved theme reactivity bugs across the Software Repository Manager and RPM Changelog console.

description.p: The Stability and Theme Reactivity Hotfix:

ul.li: Resolved native segmentation fault (core dumped) occurring ~10s after startup due to Qt proxy model persistent index desynchronization.
Synchronized layoutAboutToBeChanged and layoutChanged signals across all model updates.
Enforced reentrant thread locking (RLock) and explicit match iterator teardown across native librpm calls.
Hardened user-installed and orphan package discovery against libdnf5 SWIG director crashes.
Optimized lazy tree loading by hooking dependency queries strictly to user-triggered row expansions.
Resolved theme adaptation defects: Repository manager boxes and Changelog entries now adapt dynamically to all 6 light and dark themes.

description.p: Fix missing QIcon import in main.py (v1.8.1)
The Security Auditing, System Updates, and Engine Reliability Update:

ul.li: Stability Fixes: Resolved native segmentation faults on Fedora 44 (Qt 6.8+) caused by QProxyStyle recursion, fixed libdnf5 SWIG memory corruption, and corrected desktop file naming (#32).
Package File Integrity Auditor: Run native rpm -V file verification directly within the Files tab to detect modified checksums, permissions, or missing files.
RPM Changelog & CVE Linker: View upstream maintainer release notes extracted directly from local RPM headers with automated links to Red Hat Security Advisories and Bugzilla.
System Updates & Security Advisories: Integrated DNF5 check-upgrade engine with a dedicated "Available Updates" sidebar channel, upgrade path indicators, and status:update search filters.
Software Repository & COPR Manager: Easily enable or disable Fedora Core, updates-testing, and RPM Fusion channels, plus 1-click community COPR onboarding.
User-Installed Channel: Added a dedicated filter to view only software explicitly requested by the user, separating applications from background dependencies.
UI Polish: Fixed close button clipping defect and added fallback icon themes for headless, container, and WSL environments.

description.p: The Deterministic Classification and Engine Reliability Update:

ul.li: Full AppStream Taxonomy: Integrated all 10 Freedesktop component types (desktop, console, addon, codec, font, firmware, driver, service, localization, icon-theme).
Topological Precedence Engine: Re-architected package assignment to guarantee zero misclassifications between system infrastructure, applications, and daemons.
XDG Desktop Entry Sanitization: Resolved NoDisplay=true false-positives in system settings and protected CLI utilities shipping Terminal=true desktop files.
User-Installed Provenance: Added explicit user installation detection (is_user_installed) with new "status:user" search filter syntax.
Expanded Search Capabilities: Added advanced filter prefixes for architectures ("arch:"), primary categories ("cat:"), and secondary tags ("tag:").
Multi-Stage Transaction Safety: Staged concurrent installation and removal queues sequentially to prevent DNF command argument collisions.
Enhanced Inspector Experience: Added pretty ontology titles, provenance badges, and distinct shared library (.so) iconography.

description.p: Packaging hotfix resolving rpmbuild %prep scriptlet execution errors:

ul.li: Fixed command not found failure caused by blank lines with carriage returns in RPM spec scriptlets (#29).
Ensured clean builds under Fedora Rawhide and Mock environments.

description.p: Packaging hotfix resolving carriage return execution errors in RPM spec prep phase.
The Visuals and Precision Update: Full light/dark theming and classification anchoring:

ul.li: Introduced dynamic theming with 6 curated dark and light palettes plus System Default auto-detection.
Integrated Qt 6 FreeDesktop portal color scheme listener for automatic desktop light/dark synchronization.
Implemented strict path anchoring for typography and graphics drivers.
Enforced top-down precedence ensuring primary application roles take priority over secondary feature traits.
Resolved classification anomalies for Firefox, LibreOffice, 7zip, and PipeWire.

description.p: Fine-grained category taxonomy and classification refinement:

ul.li: Introduced dedicated categories for Graphics & 3D Drivers, Audio Architecture, Media Plugins, Desktop Addons, GUI Toolkits, and Settings Applets.
Enforced strict validation on Desktop Applications, eliminating false positives for plugins, widget toolkits, and settings dialogs.
Separated Mesa GPU drivers and PipeWire audio subsystems from minimal base infrastructure.
Resolved model-level flag override for user-installed packages.
